title.narrative: Sudan Emergency and Famine Response Intuitive (SEFRI)

description.narrative: Sudan is witnessing the largest man-made crisis in its history that continues to spiral the country into chaos, The conflict that started between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) is having a horrific toll on civilians and leading to a humanitarian crisis of significant proportions that keeps worsening. The war has caused unprecedented widespread displacement, with over 8.8 million people fleeing their homes, including an estimated 6.8 million internally displaced persons (IDPs). UN famine prevention plan highlighted the gravity of the crisis, noting that immediate action is crucial to prevent a catastrophic hunger crisis. The nutrition situation, especially among children, has worsened, with recent surveys indicating a decline compared to the previous five years. The country is facing acute food insecurity, with 17.7 million people affected and 4.9 million on the verge of famine. An integrated response is urgently needed to address the vulnerabilities and restore normalcy in terms of lives, livelihoods, basic services, and economic opportunities. Tailoring solutions to the specific context of the affected areas is essential to enhance the resilience of IDPS and host communities against current and future shocks. UNDP role in providing support and assistance is vital in averting a potential famine and stabilizing the situation in Sudan.
